traits.label: Convenes senior counsel
traits.text: Meade gathers his corps commanders to seek their opinions on whether to remain in position or retreat, and whether to attack or wait.

citation.doc: Minutes of council, July 2, 1863 (Official Records, Ser. I, Vol. 27, Part 1, scan)

traits.label: Reports factual status
traits.text: Meade communicates the current state of the battle to the General-in-Chief, noting that the enemy has made no impression on his position and that prisoners have been taken.

citation.doc: Minutes of council, July 2, 1863 (Official Records, Ser. I, Vol. 27, Part 1, scan)
citation.quote: The enemy thus far have made no impression upon my position.

traits.label: Maintains defensive posture
traits.text: Meade describes how the enemy's assault on his left center was repulsed with severe loss to the enemy, indicating a successful defensive command.

citation.doc: Minutes of council, July 2, 1863 (Official Records, Ser. I, Vol. 27, Part 1, scan)
citation.quote: assaulted my left center twice, being upon both occasions handsomely repulsed
